data.one_liner: Convert alpha-2 country codes to emoji flags in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple utility function to convert two-letter country codes into their corresponding emoji flag representations. It works as a pure Dart library across multiple platforms.
use_when: You need to display emoji flags based on country codes.
You are building a multi-platform Dart or Flutter app.
avoid_when: You need full country name lookups or extensive locale management.
strengths: Pure Dart package with no dependencies.
weaknesses: Very limited scope with only one core utility feature.
Not documented with advanced localization features.
data.setup_notes: Simply import the library and call the static conversion method.
